verdict.rationale: Zero is an open-source email app, so offering a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents only an MCP server and a list of its tools, with no OpenAPI or equivalent spec available for download. An MCP tool list is an adjacent feature and not a published API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
